description: HR-28 is the Regional Licensing Authority (RLA) code for Ferozepur Jhirka sub-division in the Nuh district of Haryana. It functions under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate office and handles the registration of private vehicles and issuance of driving licenses for the local region.
address: Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) Office, Ferozepur Jhirka, District Nuh, Haryana
